ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_0
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 今天我是有话要说才来的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_1
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……我要退出CRYCHIC

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_2
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不……是我个人的问题

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_3
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……我没说

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_5
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……就算没有我，大家也可以练习吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_6
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
没有规定人不齐就不能练。
不要把责任推到我身上

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_7
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
别说那种幼稚的话了，
灯明明是最需要练习的那个，
但至今为止你都做了什么？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_9
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……？
你是吹奏乐社的吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_10
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……！
……为什么突然这么说……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_11
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……不。抱歉。
我无法满足你的要求

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_13
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 为什么擅自到羽丘来了？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_14
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我应该说过，
我的事情不要告诉任何人吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_15
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你做了那么显眼的事情，就跟说了一样

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_16
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 能麻烦你跟她说，我已经搬家了吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_17
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 唉……睦做不出这种事呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_18
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我要走了。
睦，你可不能当传话筒哦。
再见

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_19
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
好，要开始拍了。
大家准备好了吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_20
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
睦，再往左一点。
你得有要站在正中间的念头才行

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_21
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
灯，你不用想着唱好。
只要表达出自己的感情就可以了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_22
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 好痛……没事吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_23
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
突然把你推开，我很抱歉……
但是，不要寻死啊！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_24
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你刚才是想从桥上跳下去吧！？
你在想什么！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_26
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 花和命，到底哪个重要！？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_27
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，不……
花也是有生命的吧……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_29
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……是我弄错了。
原来你没有想不开啊……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_30
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……？啊，糟糕了……
好像是把你推开的时候擦伤了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_31
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
没事。这点小伤没关系的。
那么，再见

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_33
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
明明是我误会了，
你还帮我处理伤口……总觉得很过意不去呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_34
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
话说回来，你的房间真可爱呢。
有好多漂亮的罐子和盒子……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_35
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 啊，这个笔记本……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_36
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
好怀念呢。
小时候，我也用过

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_37
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
因为封面有珍稀的动植物照片，
我以前非常中意

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_38
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
哎呀，这么多，真亏你收集得到呢。
我经常用独角仙封面的……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_39
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不、不劳烦了……
这本香豌豆封面的我也用过。
我记得它格子很大，用起来很方便……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_41
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……这些文字，是你写的吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_42
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
虽然像大家一样交到了朋友，
但和大家在一起，却觉得很孤独——

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_43
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 简直像歌词一样呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_44
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这些笔记本都是吗……？
……真棒呢！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_45
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我还没做自我介绍。
我叫丰川祥子

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_46
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你叫什么？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_47
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
灯同学……
我有一个请求

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_48
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 要不要和我组乐队？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_49
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那么，灯同学。
我来给你介绍大家

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_50
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
爽世同学是贝斯手。
她在月之森吹奏乐社担任低音大提琴手

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_51
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
在前段时间的月之森音乐节上
她的演奏非常精彩，
所以我就去找了她，请她一定要加入我们乐队

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_52
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这位是睦。
她从小就热衷弹吉他，
很值得信赖哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_53
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你又这样……
要更自信一点才行哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_54
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
睦是我的发小。
爽世同学和我同年级……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_55
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 还有一个人是鼓手，也是第一次见

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_56
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我和立希同学的姐姐以前就一直关系很好。
这次也是因此才和她联系上的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_57
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
立希同学的姐姐是羽丘吹奏乐社的社长，
个人也在比赛中取得了优秀的成绩，是很优秀的演奏者哦。
最近她还参加了地区的管弦乐队，听说在里面很是活跃

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_58
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不好意思。言归正传

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_59
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
咳咳……再次感谢各位
今天能聚集在这里

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_60
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 我一直很期待和大家见面

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_61
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
今后，我们就是乐队了……
我们会成为一起演奏音乐的命运共同体

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_62
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 嗯，很棒吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_63
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
好问题。
大家知道一支叫Morfonica的乐队吗？
是月之森的学姐们组成的乐队……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_64
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯，我也在那次音乐节上，
听了Morfonica的合奏

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_65
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我感受到了优雅中隐藏着的强大的力量，
最重要的是，感受到了她们组乐队的快乐……
这让我深受感动

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_66
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
所以，我希望
能够演奏Morfonica的乐曲……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_67
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
也希望将来，我们能合奏
属于我们自己的歌曲

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_68
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不，一点都不高。
到时候由我来作曲……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_69
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 而且重要的是，这位灯同学，是个作词天才

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_70
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 灯同学，能给大家看看那个笔记本吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_71
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
灯同学家里，
有好多写了歌词的笔记本

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_72
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
至于曲子，我曾经用钢琴弹过，
找时间在录音棚弹给你们听

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_73
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……灯同学，你可是主唱哦？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_74
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……灯同学，不用太失落。
今天是第一次，失败是在所难免的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_75
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你只是不习惯在别人面前唱歌而已。
只要多练习几次，肯定就……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_77
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……那首歌的歌词，是你写的。
肯定是你来演唱最合适

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_78
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 因为灯同学的歌词，是发自内心的呐喊

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_79
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……我想要！成为人类——！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_80
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
汽车的声音这么响。
我的声音不会有人听到的

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_81
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
在这座天桥上可以尽情呐喊哦。
来，灯同学也一起喊吧！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_82
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 灯！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_83
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
只要想做，你就能做到嘛……！
就要这种气势！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_84
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
没关系，肯定会有好办法的！
下次练习的时候，和大家商量一下吧！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_85
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我已经久闻这里的大名了……
有这样能自由地唱喜欢的歌的房间，真是太棒了呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_86
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 或许在家里做一个也不错呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_87
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 嗯，我觉得这是一个很棒的主意

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_88
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我是第一次来卡拉OK店，
在这里的话，灯也能开心练习了吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_89
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
啊，那个我也很惊讶！
只要按一下按钮，居然就会有饮料出来……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_90
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
而且还有很多种类呢。
灯选了哪个？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_91
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 那就要快点尝尝味道才行！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_92
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
房间的灯光不停变换……
甚至还有灯球呢！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_93
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 哎呀！灯光开始闪烁了！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_94
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
咦？声音没了哦。
不是轮到我了吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_95
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不用在意。
来，轮到灯唱了哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_96
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你的歌声很好听呢，灯！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_97
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
那么，接下来轮到我了呢！
我会尽全力唱的！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_98
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
……呼！
我的歌声怎么样！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_99
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 睦本来就会笑啊

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_100
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 这就是灯写的新歌词……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_101
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……我能懂。这是……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_103
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不好意思……灯的感受和心情……
都好好传达到了我心里……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_104
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 『春日影』……是属于我们的歌呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_105
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
当然。
我会写一首配得上灯的歌词的曲子

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_106
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
还有……我们的乐队名。
叫CRYCHIC怎么样？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_107
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不，是『CRYCHIC』

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_108
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: CRY是呐喊，CHIC则是优雅和高尚的意思……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_109
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯，让更多人听见……
高雅心灵的呐喊吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_110
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 刚才的歌声，很棒哦！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_111
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
谢谢大家。
我们是CRYCHIC！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_112
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我都说不出话来了……
居然拿出了这么棒的一场演出……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_113
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你让我们值得纪念的日子——
CRYCHIC的初次演出，取得了巨大成功哦！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_114
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……我们以后一定要再办演出啊！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_115
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
哎呀……！有这么多评论……
『歌词完全戳中我了』『太棒了』……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_118
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不必了，我没什么要说的。
再见

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_120
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……和那没有关系

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_121
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
我没有什么要对你说的！
不要再来找我了！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_122
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 『春日影』的乐谱，我已经按你的想法改好了哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_123
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
如果还有其他想改的地方，请随时告诉我。
这是我身为作曲者的责任

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_124
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
到底是怎么回事？
今天她又来了！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_125
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
嗯，最近她每天
都在羽丘校门口等着

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_126
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 这是在讽刺我吗……？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_127
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
唉……越是躲避，
她就越穷追不舍是吧。
真头痛

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_128
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 看来有必要和她谈一谈呢……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_129
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ！我怎么可能去……！

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_130
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……有其他方案吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_131
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……是什么时候？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_132
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……这就是灯唱的歌？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_134
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ……她在干什么啊

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_142
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不用在这里假仁假义的了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_143
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
如果是演奏的话，请随意。
想怎么演奏都行

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_144
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
总是抓着过去紧紧不放，很难看呢。
你差不多也该忘了吧？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_145
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 命运……

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_146
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 那么，你现在的乐队又算什么？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_147
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
不是什么？
你的语言和行动是矛盾的哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_148
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
CRYCHIC已经破碎了。
绝对不可能复活

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_150
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 睦。是这样吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_151
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 所以，我才亲手结束了它

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_152
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 没有人拜托你做这种事

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_153
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
这是最后通牒。
从今以后，不要再来找我了

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_155
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你是抱着多大的决心说这句话的？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_156
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
你只不过是一名普通的学生，
能够承担别人的人生吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_157
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
『什么都可以做』，是很沉重的话。
不要随便说自己无法实现的事情

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_159
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 你一心只为自己考虑呢

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_160
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 长崎爽世同学？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_161
ws_voice_1_0#2.text:
冒昧问你一个问题，
你对乐队感兴趣吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_163
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: 不必了，没关系

ws_voice_1_0#2.name: voice_164
ws_voice_1_0#2.text: ——祝你幸福

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_0
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 今天我是有话要说才来的

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_1
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……我要退出CRYCHIC

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_2
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 不……是我个人的问题

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_3
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……我没说

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_4
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_5
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……就算没有我，大家也可以练习吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_6
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
没有规定人不齐就不能练。
不要把责任推到我身上

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_7
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
别说那种幼稚的话了，
灯明明是最需要练习的那个，
但至今为止你都做了什么？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_8
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_9
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……？
你是吹奏乐社的吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_10
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……！
……为什么突然这么说……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_11
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……不。抱歉。
我无法满足你的要求

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_12
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_13
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 为什么擅自到羽丘来了？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_14
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我应该说过，
我的事情不要告诉任何人吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_15
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 你做了那么显眼的事情，就跟说了一样

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_16
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 能麻烦你跟她说，我已经搬家了吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_17
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 唉……睦做不出这种事呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_18
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我要走了。
睦，你可不能当传话筒哦。
再见

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_19
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
好，要开始拍了。
大家准备好了吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_20
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
睦，再往左一点。
你得有要站在正中间的念头才行

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_21
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
灯，你不用想着唱好。
只要表达出自己的感情就可以了

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_22
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 好痛……没事吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_23
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
突然把你推开，我很抱歉……
但是，不要寻死啊！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_24
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
你刚才是想从桥上跳下去吧！？
你在想什么！？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_25
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_26
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 花和命，到底哪个重要！？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_27
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
啊，不……
花也是有生命的吧……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_28
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_29
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……是我弄错了。
原来你没有想不开啊……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_30
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……？啊，糟糕了……
好像是把你推开的时候擦伤了

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_31
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
没事。这点小伤没关系的。
那么，再见

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_32
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_33
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
明明是我误会了，
你还帮我处理伤口……总觉得很过意不去呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_34
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
话说回来，你的房间真可爱呢。
有好多漂亮的罐子和盒子……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_35
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 啊，这个笔记本……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_36
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
好怀念呢。
小时候，我也用过

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_37
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
因为封面有珍稀的动植物照片，
我以前非常中意

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_38
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
哎呀，这么多，真亏你收集得到呢。
我经常用独角仙封面的……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_39
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
不、不劳烦了……
这本香豌豆封面的我也用过。
我记得它格子很大，用起来很方便……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_40
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_41
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……这些文字，是你写的吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_42
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
虽然像大家一样交到了朋友，
但和大家在一起，却觉得很孤独——

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_43
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 简直像歌词一样呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_44
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
这些笔记本都是吗……？
……真棒呢！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_45
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我还没做自我介绍。
我叫丰川祥子

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_46
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 你叫什么？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_47
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
灯同学……
我有一个请求

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_48
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 要不要和我组乐队？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_49
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
那么，灯同学。
我来给你介绍大家

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_50
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
爽世同学是贝斯手。
她在月之森吹奏乐社担任低音大提琴手

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_51
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
在前段时间的月之森音乐节上
她的演奏非常精彩，
所以我就去找了她，请她一定要加入我们乐队

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_52
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
这位是睦。
她从小就热衷弹吉他，
很值得信赖哦

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_53
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
你又这样……
要更自信一点才行哦

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_54
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
睦是我的发小。
爽世同学和我同年级……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_55
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 还有一个人是鼓手，也是第一次见

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_56
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我和立希同学的姐姐以前就一直关系很好。
这次也是因此才和她联系上的

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_57
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
立希同学的姐姐是羽丘吹奏乐社的社长，
个人也在比赛中取得了优秀的成绩，是很优秀的演奏者哦。
最近她还参加了地区的管弦乐队，听说在里面很是活跃

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_58
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 不好意思。言归正传

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_59
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
咳咳……再次感谢各位
今天能聚集在这里

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_60
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 我一直很期待和大家见面

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_61
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
今后，我们就是乐队了……
我们会成为一起演奏音乐的命运共同体

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_62
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 嗯，很棒吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_63
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
好问题。
大家知道一支叫Morfonica的乐队吗？
是月之森的学姐们组成的乐队……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_64
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
嗯，我也在那次音乐节上，
听了Morfonica的合奏

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_65
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我感受到了优雅中隐藏着的强大的力量，
最重要的是，感受到了她们组乐队的快乐……
这让我深受感动

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_66
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
所以，我希望
能够演奏Morfonica的乐曲……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_67
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
也希望将来，我们能合奏
属于我们自己的歌曲

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_68
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
不，一点都不高。
到时候由我来作曲……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_69
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 而且重要的是，这位灯同学，是个作词天才

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_70
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 灯同学，能给大家看看那个笔记本吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_71
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
灯同学家里，
有好多写了歌词的笔记本

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_72
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
至于曲子，我曾经用钢琴弹过，
找时间在录音棚弹给你们听

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_73
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……灯同学，你可是主唱哦？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_74
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……灯同学，不用太失落。
今天是第一次，失败是在所难免的

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_75
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
你只是不习惯在别人面前唱歌而已。
只要多练习几次，肯定就……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_76
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_77
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……那首歌的歌词，是你写的。
肯定是你来演唱最合适

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_78
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 因为灯同学的歌词，是发自内心的呐喊

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_79
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……我想要！成为人类——！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_80
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
汽车的声音这么响。
我的声音不会有人听到的

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_81
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
在这座天桥上可以尽情呐喊哦。
来，灯同学也一起喊吧！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_82
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 灯！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_83
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
只要想做，你就能做到嘛……！
就要这种气势！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_84
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
没关系，肯定会有好办法的！
下次练习的时候，和大家商量一下吧！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_85
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我已经久闻这里的大名了……
有这样能自由地唱喜欢的歌的房间，真是太棒了呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_86
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 或许在家里做一个也不错呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_87
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 嗯，我觉得这是一个很棒的主意

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_88
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我是第一次来卡拉OK店，
在这里的话，灯也能开心练习了吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_89
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
啊，那个我也很惊讶！
只要按一下按钮，居然就会有饮料出来……！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_90
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
而且还有很多种类呢。
灯选了哪个？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_91
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 那就要快点尝尝味道才行！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_92
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
房间的灯光不停变换……
甚至还有灯球呢！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_93
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 哎呀！灯光开始闪烁了！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_94
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
咦？声音没了哦。
不是轮到我了吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_95
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
不用在意。
来，轮到灯唱了哦

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_96
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 你的歌声很好听呢，灯！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_97
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
那么，接下来轮到我了呢！
我会尽全力唱的！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_98
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
……呼！
我的歌声怎么样！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_99
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 睦本来就会笑啊

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_100
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 这就是灯写的新歌词……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_101
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……我能懂。这是……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_102
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_103
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
不好意思……灯的感受和心情……
都好好传达到了我心里……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_104
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 『春日影』……是属于我们的歌呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_105
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
当然。
我会写一首配得上灯的歌词的曲子

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_106
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
还有……我们的乐队名。
叫CRYCHIC怎么样？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_107
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 不，是『CRYCHIC』

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_108
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: CRY是呐喊，CHIC则是优雅和高尚的意思……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_109
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
嗯，让更多人听见……
高雅心灵的呐喊吧

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_110
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 刚才的歌声，很棒哦！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_111
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
谢谢大家。
我们是CRYCHIC！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_112
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我都说不出话来了……
居然拿出了这么棒的一场演出……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_113
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
你让我们值得纪念的日子——
CRYCHIC的初次演出，取得了巨大成功哦！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_114
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……我们以后一定要再办演出啊！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_115
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
哎呀……！有这么多评论……
『歌词完全戳中我了』『太棒了』……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_116
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_117
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_118
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
不必了，我没什么要说的。
再见

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_119
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_120
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……和那没有关系

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_121
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
我没有什么要对你说的！
不要再来找我了！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_122
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 『春日影』的乐谱，我已经按你的想法改好了哦

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_123
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
如果还有其他想改的地方，请随时告诉我。
这是我身为作曲者的责任

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_124
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
到底是怎么回事？
今天她又来了！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_125
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
嗯，最近她每天
都在羽丘校门口等着

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_126
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 这是在讽刺我吗……？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_127
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
唉……越是躲避，
她就越穷追不舍是吧。
真头痛

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_128
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 看来有必要和她谈一谈呢……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_129
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ！我怎么可能去……！

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_130
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……有其他方案吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_131
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……是什么时候？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_132
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……这就是灯唱的歌？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_133
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_134
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ……她在干什么啊

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_135
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_136
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_137
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_138
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_139
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_140
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_141
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_142
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 不用在这里假仁假义的了

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_143
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
如果是演奏的话，请随意。
想怎么演奏都行

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_144
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
总是抓着过去紧紧不放，很难看呢。
你差不多也该忘了吧？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_145
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 命运……

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_146
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 那么，你现在的乐队又算什么？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_147
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
不是什么？
你的语言和行动是矛盾的哦

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_148
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
CRYCHIC已经破碎了。
绝对不可能复活

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_149
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_150
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 睦。是这样吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_151
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 所以，我才亲手结束了它

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_152
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 没有人拜托你做这种事

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_153
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
这是最后通牒。
从今以后，不要再来找我了

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_154
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_155
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 你是抱着多大的决心说这句话的？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_156
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
你只不过是一名普通的学生，
能够承担别人的人生吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_157
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
『什么都可以做』，是很沉重的话。
不要随便说自己无法实现的事情

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_158
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_159
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 你一心只为自己考虑呢

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_160
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 长崎爽世同学？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_161
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text:
冒昧问你一个问题，
你对乐队感兴趣吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_162
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_163
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: 不必了，没关系

ws_voice_1_1#2.name: voice_164
ws_voice_1_1#2.post_command: lip_sync enable; start_mtn garupa_l2d_carrier_sakiko ws_voice_finished_4#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.text: ——祝你幸福
